name: Session Overview
description: Entry point for planning sessions. Reads current session state and project context without requiring agent interaction. Auto-advances upon completion.
use_cases: Start of any planning or project session - reads current state
Session resumption - gather context from previous work
Cross-team handoff - establish shared understanding of project state
example_todo_section: No todo items - this node auto-advances after reading session context.
notes: This node type should be the entry point for all planning DAGs. It reads from session state without requiring any tool invocation or agent dispatch. Use for establishing shared context at the start of a session.
